verdict.rationale: No evidence pack items describe automatic suppression of unsubscribes, bounces, or spam complaints, nor honoring suppression lists across transactional and marketing sends; the community thread even raises a concern about pricing encouraging unlimited sends without addressing suppression handling. Missing for 10: documentation of automatic unsubscribe/bounce/complaint suppression, cross-send-type enforcement, and CAN-SPAM/GDPR compliance details.
